what_differs: On 2026-09-30 WagerTech and Jumpr agreed to rename Retired to Archive and to remove Review Required. The WAGR-39 epic (baseline v0.12, last updated before that meeting) and the build stories WAGR-498, WAGR-489 and WAGR-458 still name Retired, Review Required and New in their rules and acceptance criteria, while WAGR-506/485/486/454 already use Draft/Archived.
suggested_action: Suggestion only: update the WAGR-39 outbound-scope and identity-rule sections to the v0.13.1 status set, and replace Retired/Review Required/New in WAGR-498 (rule list and AC 8), WAGR-489 and WAGR-458 with Archived/Draft. Also confirm with WagerTech the 'Draft' label: the last meeting record (L3302, 2026-09-29) says 'New', and no meeting records the rename to Draft.
